name: BestHelpTool Product Descriptions for WooCommerce
author: besthelptool

sections.description:
Generate high-quality, SEO-optimized product descriptions for your WooCommerce store in seconds using AI! Powered by OpenAI, this plugin allows you to easily create engaging content based on product titles, attributes, and tags.

Features:
* Single product generation from the product edit screen
* Generates both short and long descriptions
* Unlimited single product generations
* Upgrade to Pro for Bulk Generation, Custom Tones & Languages, and SEO Options!

External Services

This plugin relies on third-party AI services (by default OpenAI) to generate product descriptions.
– What data is sent: The product title, product tags, product categories, and attributes are sent to the AI API endpoint configured in the settings.
– Why it is sent: To generate contextual and accurate product descriptions using AI.
– Terms of Service: OpenAI Terms of Use
– Privacy Policy: OpenAI Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/wc-ai-description-gen directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Navigate to WooCommerce > AI Descriptions to set up your API Key.
sections.faq:
Do I need an OpenAI API Key?

Yes, you need to provide your own OpenAI API key to use the service. You can set a custom endpoint if using a compatible API.

What features are in the Pro version?

Bulk generation, unlimited generations, SEO mode, Tone & Language selection.
